title: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished landscape title-screen background for Trætoppen, a cozy Danish isometric woodland game. Reference image 1 is the project's environment design, reference image 2 is the original child's bat drawing, reference image 3 is the character design grammar. Create a beautiful hand-drawn children's-book illustration as a master illustrator lovingly interpreting the child's drawing: playful imperfect shapes, huge round eyes with dark pupils and a tiny white glint, three short cheek strokes, enormous heads and little bodies. Scene: a magical village of little round straw-roofed houses and vegetable gardens on wooden platforms high in giant forest trees, crooked hanging bridges, warm tiny lanterns, leafy branches, a friendly orange fox with a green scarf and a cream rabbit exploring the right side. Luminous spring sage greens, honey ochre, warm cream, muted lavender, soft teal. Medium: matte gouache and watercolor washes on warm ivory paper, confident slightly wandering sepia pencil contours, delicate colored-pencil hatching, obvious organic pigment texture and visible brushstrokes. Handcrafted, whimsical, sophisticated, warm. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, artwork fills canvas. Quiet pale mist and very sparse leaf shapes on the LEFT 40 percent so the game's existing title and menu are readable; the village and characters concentrated on the RIGHT and lower center. Leave upper left quiet. No lettering, labels, UI, border, watermark. Avoid 3D rendering, shiny clay, vector-flat cartoon, photorealism, mechanically perfect shapes.
